title: Prove that equal-weight cycle arcs meet the touching diameter
body:
## Summary
- On every equal-weight cycle, every proper arc has Schur bandwidth equal to the touching diameter. The rim routes are at least one past the width, and every touching pair stays negative.
- Deleting one vertex on length 9 at width 1 leaves entry `-1/16` and bandwidth 2, with inverse norms `528/265` inside `2` and `6`. At width 2 the far rim entry is `-1/64` and the bandwidth is 4.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
